capabilities: expand pasted YouTube URLs into titled links
format links as Channel: Video Title or title only
embed videos inline instead of linking
show a loading placeholder while the title is fetched
extras: The manifest carries the note 'This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.'
problem: Pasted YouTube links in notes are bare URLs whose titles must be looked up and written manually.
summary: Expands pasted YouTube URLs into readable Markdown links showing the channel name and video title.
